caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical or cast iron toy featuring a rider on a horse. The rider wears a helmet and has a dark complexion with detailed facial features, and he is dressed in a dark shirt and red pants. The horse is primarily brown with black details on the mane and tail, and has a harness and saddle depicted in darker shades. Both the rider and the horse are positioned on a rectangular base that is painted red with black edges and has a scalloped design along the side. The base includes a green platform, which appears textured, and at one end there is an object resembling a bush or a rock also colored in green. The artist's name, "FLORIAN ROKITA," is written in small black text in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is plain and beige.
title: Toy Bank: "I Always Did 'Spise a Mule"
